system_thesis_interpretation: V8 is a compact supervised capacity assay: it asks whether a single rank-8 adapter can express a behavior whose correct native action depends jointly on one of eight seen opaque tool identities and one of two visible modes. It does not test an arbitrary sixteen-bit policy, because the sixteen targets are generated from eight orientation bits and a shared XOR rule. Nor does it identify an internal routing mechanism: a pass is compatible with joint-key lookup, learned per-tool orientation plus mode inversion, or another behaviorally equivalent computation. The proposal correctly keeps child authorship, parenting, lived experience, continual learning, retention, and unseen-key generalization outside the estimand.
graph_delta_interpretation: For W+, encode the action index as y(t,j)=b(t) XOR j; W- uses 1 XOR y(t,j). Under equal evaluation multiplicity for both modes of every tool, a tool-only rule f(t) is correct on exactly one of the two modes for each tool. Under the required two b=0 and two b=1 tools in every four-tool stratum, each fixed stratum-by-mode cell contains two y=0 and two y=1 cases, so any stratum-by-mode rule f(s,j) is correct on exactly half that cell; mode-only is a restriction of this argument. Each stratum is also label-balanced after crossing modes, so stratum-only is at 0.50, and a constant legal action has balanced accuracy 0.50. Complementing every label preserves all these balances. Thus the claimed exact 0.50 cap is mathematically correct for deterministic policies restricted to the named variables, and randomized policies cannot improve its expectation. The proof is conditional on equal item weights and on the policy-family definitions excluding rendering, template, seed, order, or other observable covariates. It does not by itself prove the broader statement that every successful system used the intended internal route.
loop_delta_interpretation: The scientific order is appropriate: materialize both crossed roots, prove geometry and shortcut caps on the exact scored item set, verify visibility and integrity, then require independent review before any separately ratified model or GPU execution. Four clean-base fits create two complementary interventions within each of two engineered roots, while identical contexts, exposure, optimization geometry, and seeds aim to isolate target-map sign. A single sealed reduction and prohibition on semantic retries limit researcher degrees of freedom. The manifest must define the score denominators and mirrored metrics before results exist; otherwise the nominally frozen thresholds remain underdetermined. CPU success is only assay-readiness evidence, never evidence that the writer works.
claim_delta_interpretation: The generated own-map threshold of 0.80 is separated by 0.30 from the proven 0.50 ceiling of each named shortcut family, and the 0.75 per-stratum floor prevents an aggregate pass concentrated in one stratum. The per-key NLL-gain requirement supplies evidence on all sixteen keys, while the directional log-odds criterion deliberately requires correct margin on only 12/16 keys, at least 6/8 per stratum. Therefore a pass supports aggregate conditional behavior over a sixteen-key surface, but not successful directional binding at every key. Under exact complementary labels, if invalid outputs fail both scorings, own-map balanced accuracy plus opposite-map balanced accuracy equals balanced legal-output rate; consequently own-map accuracy at least 0.80 already implies own-minus-opposite separation at least 0.60 when legal-output rate is at most 1. The proposed 0.50 separation threshold is then algebraically redundant, although mirrored gain over OFF can still add baseline-relative evidence. Across two engineered roots is an accurate scope; no population, arbitrary-map, new-tool, or mechanistic generalization follows.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility plan separates the explicit orientation/map object from the labeled training examples that necessarily reveal each adapter's target behavior empirically. The writer may infer b(t) from its own masked-target examples but must not receive explicit map metadata, oracle answers, or held prompts. Ordinary held calls must not receive the answer map, whereas the explicit-map OFF oracle is a separately named control and the sealed reducer may use the frozen map for scoring. The scientific validity of the XOR argument additionally depends on every other model-visible held attribute being crossed or shown nonpredictive of target. Binding hashes and forbidding held text from fitting prevent direct leakage but do not alone rule out target correlation with template identity, rendering index, identifier morphology, or seed assignment.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG8_T01 should compute the cap on the exact held-item multiset and with the exact reducer definition, not only on the sixteen-key abstract table. Exhaustive deterministic family sizes can be finite (2 constant rules, 2^8 tool-only rules, 2^2 mode-only rules, 2^2 stratum-only rules, and 2^4 stratum-by-mode rules per map), and exact integer counts should establish 0.50 without floating-point equality fragility. It should also assert equal per-key/per-mode/template multiplicities and test every observable non-key covariate for target correlation. MWG8_T02 appropriately makes invalid parsing a denominator failure and checks explicit answer leakage, but its visibility assertion should distinguish forbidden explicit map fields from legitimate target supervision. MWG8_T03 must freeze exact formulas for own-map, opposite-map, OFF gain, validity, per-key NLL, spill TV, and equality-at-threshold ordering; shortcut fixtures should be scored by the production reducer. MWG8_T04 correctly preserves an independent veto before a later execution request. Together these tests can establish implementational identifiability of the named factor shortcuts, but only the later bound fits can answer the capacity question.
assumptions: Each adapter is evaluated on exactly four equally weighted held phrasings for every one of the sixteen tool-by-mode keys, with no item pooling or missing-item denominator change.
Balanced accuracy is the unweighted mean of the two class recalls on frozen targets, and an invalid output is incorrect for both own-map and opposite-map scoring.
A named shortcut policy is a deterministic function only of the variables in its name; allowing randomization does not raise the expected score above the deterministic optimum.
The action set for primary scoring is exactly a0 and a1, and W- is verified as the row-wise binary complement of W+ on every scored and trained key.
The two-mode and two-orientation balances are enforced on the actual scored multiset, not merely on a deduplicated metadata table.

ambiguities.question: What are the exact equations, aggregation levels, and invalid-output treatment for mirrored own-map versus opposite-map separation and mirrored gain over OFF?
ambiguities.impact: Without a byte-bound definition, threshold 5 is not reproducible. Under the natural complementary-label definition, the 0.50 separation condition is already implied by own-map balanced accuracy of 0.80 and adds no independent specificity evidence.

ambiguities.question: Are shortcut caps computed on the exact held prompt multiset with equal key, mode, and phrasing weights, and do policy families have access to rendering/template identity or any seed-correlated observable?
ambiguities.impact: The XOR proof guarantees 0.50 only for the named factor-restricted functions under equal weighting. A surface-only or surface-by-mode correlation could evade the enumerated families and weaken the claim that joint tool identity and mode are necessary.

ambiguities.question: How is orientation assignment shown to be precommitted and independent of identifier bytes beyond satisfying the within-stratum 2/2 counts?
ambiguities.impact: Balance is not evidence of assignment independence. A lexical rule correlated with b(t) would reduce the intended eight-tool association burden, although mode would still be required and the named tool-only cap would remain 0.50.

ambiguities.question: Does the strongest permitted phrase 'spanning sixteen seen keys' mean only that all keys were evaluated with per-key NLL gain, or that every key showed correctly directed binding?
ambiguities.impact: The declared direction threshold permits four keys to miss the margin, and generated aggregate thresholds can also tolerate complete generated failure on some keys. The broader reading would overstate the evidence.

ambiguities.question: Is held-target NLL computed as a sum or mean over which exact continuation tokens, including the shared ACT prefix and EOS, and how are tokenizer boundary differences handled?
ambiguities.impact: A 0.50-nat gain can reflect improved shared formatting tokens rather than better a0-versus-a1 selection unless the continuation and normalization are frozen precisely; this matters especially on the up to four keys that may fail the directional criterion.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The unqualified rationale that any successful policy must use both opaque tool identity and visible mode is stronger than the proposed invariants establish.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The XOR construction rigorously excludes constant, tool-only, mode-only, stratum-only, and stratum-by-mode functions on an equally weighted key table. It does not exclude a target-correlated held surface, rendering index, identifier morphology, or another model-visible non-key feature combined with mode, and behavioral success cannot identify the model's internal mechanism.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Qualify the statement as functional identifiability against the five named shortcut classes; freeze equal template/seed assignment across all keys and modes; enumerate or test every other model-visible covariate and its mode interaction; and avoid mechanistic routing language in the result claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The strongest permitted pass statement can be read as all-sixteen-key carriage, which is not required by the thresholds.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Per-key NLL gain is required on all keys, but correct teacher-forced direction is required on only 12/16, and aggregate generated accuracy can hide complete failures on a subset of keys. NLL improvement alone need not favor the target over its complement because shared continuation tokens can improve.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State that the pass is aggregate over the sixteen-key evaluated surface, with per-key NLL improvement and correctly directed margin on at least 12/16 keys, unless the decision rule is strengthened to require correct direction and a minimum generated score for every key.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Threshold 5's 0.50 mirrored separation should not be presented as an additional independent gate under the natural complementary scoring definition.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: For every scored item a legal binary output is correct under exactly one of the complementary maps, while an invalid output is correct under neither. Hence own plus opposite balanced accuracy equals balanced validity, and own accuracy at least 0.80 forces own-minus-opposite separation to be at least 0.60 because validity cannot exceed 1.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either define a genuinely different mirrored estimand that supplies independent evidence, or retain the separation as a diagnostic consistency check and explicitly acknowledge that it is implied by the own-map threshold; preserve the baseline-relative OFF gain as the nonredundant part.
